#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import sys
import os

HEADER_TEMPLATE_PATH = './html/template/header.html'
FOOTER_TEMPLATE_PATH = './html/template/footer.html'

def load_template(file_path):
    """Loads the content of a template file."""
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        print(f"Warning: Template file not found at {file_path}. Skipping template usage.", file=sys.stderr)
        return None
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error loading template {file_path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None

def run_org_to_slides(input_path: str, output_path: str):
    """Main orchestration function."""
    print(f"Starting org-to-slide conversion:", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Input: {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Output: {output_path}", file=sys.stderr)
    try:
        with open(input_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            html_content = f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"Error: Input file not found at {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    soup = BeautifulSoup('<html><body>ciccia</body></html>', 'html.parser')
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser')
    body = soup.find('body')
    #body_content = body.findChildren(recursive=False)
    # 5. Load templates
    with open(HEADER_TEMPLATE_PATH, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        header = f.read()
    with open(FOOTER_TEMPLATE_PATH, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        footer = f.read()

    final_html = header + str(body) + footer
    try:
        with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(final_html)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error writing output file: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert a full Org-exported HTML document into a slide presentation.")
    parser.add_argument("input_file", help="Path to the full HTML file generated by Org-mode (e.g., agent_call.html).")
    parser.add_argument("output_file", help="Path to save the slide presentation (e.g., agent_call_slide.html).")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run_org_to_slides(args.input_file, args.output_file)

import re

def slugify(text):
    """Convert text to a URL-friendly slug."""
    if not text:
        return id
    text = text.strip()
    # lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # replace special characters with hyphens
    text = re.sub(r'[\W]+', '-', text)
    # remove leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    # replace multiple hyphens with single
    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    return text or 'section'

def wrap_h2_sections(body):
    """Wrap each h2 section in a div with class='slide' and id based on h2 title."""
    # Find all h2 elements
    h2_list = body.find_all('h2')
    if not h2_list:
        return body
    
    # Process from last to first to not break the DOM while iterating
    for h2 in reversed(h2_list):
        title = h2.get_text(strip=True)
        slide_id = slugify(title)
        
        # Get all content until next h2 or body end
        h2_content = body.find_next_sibling('h3')
        
        # Build content fragment starting after this h2
        content = str(h2.next_element)
        
        # Find the parent of h2 and wrap
        parent = h2.parent
        if parent:
            # Create a div wrapper and insert content after h2
            div = soup.new_tag('div', class_='slide', id=slide_id)
            # Find the current h2 and move it inside div
            h2_copy = soup.new_tag('h2')
            h2_copy.string = h2.get_text()
            div.append(h2_copy)
            div.insert(0, content)
            # Replace original h2 with div
            parent.replace_with(div)
    
    return body, header, footer

def run_org_to_slides(input_path: str, output_path: str):
    """Main orchestration function."""
    print(f"Starting org-to-slide conversion:", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Input: {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Output: {output_path}", file=sys.stderr)
    try:
        with open(input_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            html_content = f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"Error: Input file not found at {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    soup = BeautifulSoup('<html><body>ciccia</body></html>', 'html.parser')
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser')
    body = soup.find('body')
    #body_content = body.findChildren(recursive=False)
    # 5. Load templates
    with open(HEADER_TEMPLATE_PATH, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        header = f.read()
    with open(FOOTER_TEMPLATE_PATH, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        footer = f.read()

    # Wrap h2 sections in slide divs
    header, footer = wrap_h2_sections(soup, body, header, footer)

    final_html = header + str(body) + footer
